issues.competing_evidence: Hartley+05 gives i>65 deg as a pure estimate; Ribeiro & Diaz+07 formal interval 45–75; Linnell+09 adopts 65±2 and fits the SED; Hewitt+20 uses 60 deg as model input; Gilmozzi & Selvelli+24 adopt 60±15 after reporting Bruch ~65, la Dous <50 and Puebla ~30–50 from prior literature. Some underlying original values are only secondarily checked.
issues.why_it_matters: Inclination corrections affect disk luminosity and accretion-rate estimates; choosing one branch may change population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Keep each model/literature branch separate; do not publish one canonical inclination. For a single-value analysis, choose a method-specific branch and inspect the original sources and eclipse evidence.

issues.competing_evidence: 2SXPS row 175084 gives 0.3–10 keV power-law observed 3.821e-12 and unabsorbed 5.22e-12 erg cm-2 s-1. Ridder+23 gives 4.8±0.5e-12 (1–10 keV) and 6.1±0.6e-12 (0.1–10 keV), with 10% error floor and 7-keV MEKAL assumption for novalikes lacking source fit; absorbed convention/epoch is unspecified.
issues.why_it_matters: Band, absorption convention and assumed spectrum change X-ray luminosity and radio/X-ray comparisons; values are not known simultaneous.
issues.needed_action: Keep native 2SXPS observed/unabsorbed products and Ridder comparison bands separate. Choose a preferred value only after checking source-specific spectrum/NH and observation epoch.

issues.competing_evidence: Hewitt+20 configures 856 MHz bandwidth centered 1.284 GHz (0.856–1.712 GHz); Ridder+23 labels the same 256±26 μJy point as 0.43–2.1 GHz. Compatibility band uses the primary setup and retains Ridder label in the ledger.
issues.why_it_matters: Incorrect passband metadata can distort spectral-energy and population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Confirm whether Ridder band is a generic label or compilation error; use Hewitt exact setup for frequency-sensitive analysis meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: SIMBAD sp_type=sdB cites Bond & Landolt (1971). Its title/abstract describe a peculiar subluminous B-type star and possible WD relation; only abstract metadata checked. Cowley et al. (1977) full article identifies the close accreting binary, later classified as nova-like CV.
issues.why_it_matters: Using a legacy preliminary spectrum as a WD atmospheric or donor subtype would misidentify binary components.
issues.needed_action: Keep sdB only as historical metadata. Retrieve and inspect the full 1971 article if a definitive explanation/correction is needed.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

issues.competing_evidence: Gilmozzi & Selvelli+24 independently derive E(B−V)=0.02±0.02 using the IUE 2175 Å feature. Original Verbunt/Bruch & Engel source rows were not checked.
issues.why_it_matters: Reddening affects intrinsic color/M_G; current Gaia CMD remains observed unresolved-system values without extinction correction.
issues.needed_action: Keep branches separate; do not publish intrinsic BP−RP or extinction-corrected M_G until original source chain and appropriate Gaia-band correction are verified.

Audited for IM Eri: Table 1 gives distance 191.2 +/-1.4 pc and Porb=0.1456348(4) d from Armstrong+13_IMEri; Section 2.5 identifies IM Eri as a non-eclipsing novalike with blue-shifted He I 5876 and super/suborbital signals; Table 3 gives first radio detection 99 +/-26 microJy, Lnu=4.3 +/-1.1e15 erg/s/Hz, alpha=1.2 +/-1.6; Table 4 uses assumed M1=0.75 Msun, M2=0.24 Msun, i=57 deg, Mdot=2.5e-9 Msun/yr for a disk SED model and notes the IM Eri Mdot is particularly uncertain because no UV data and assumed binary parameters. Audited for V347 Pup: Table 1 gives distance 295.8 +/-1.4 pc and Porb=0.231936060(6) d from Thoroughgood+05_V347Pup; Section 2.9 summarizes eclipsing novalike/SW Sex-like nature, possible historical IP suggestion but no coherent optical pulsations/no strong magnetic evidence, q=0.83 +/-0.05, M1=0.63 +/-0.04 Msun, M2=0.52 +/-0.06 Msun, i=84.0 +/-2.3 deg, and M0.5V donor; Table 3 gives radio non-detection <30 microJy; Section 4.1 notes a weak 28 +/-14 microJy signal was rejected as below 5sigma/offset/not beam-consistent; Table 4 uses Mdot=6e-9 Msun/yr.
